summary: Shah supported Israel's war to destroy Hamas in 2026, backed U.S. Iron Dome funding per a JDCA report, and voiced support for Israel in October 2023. His expressed sympathy for Palestinians was limited to lamenting civilian casualties in Gaza while citing his Jain faith. Hindu American PAC endorsed his campaign. A JDCA report also notes his support for a two-state solution, but his documented positions center on backing Israel's military objectives and U.S. arms funding.
